feedback: If the per-100 g column is read as if it were the portion, point to the per-portion column or show the scaling step.
If kJ and kcal are treated as interchangeable, clarify they are two different units for the same energy.
Use this as a lead-in before independent calculation, then move straight into summing a real day.
activities.intendedInsight: A nutrition label encodes several distinct figures; reading the correct unit and the correct column is a prerequisite to any valid energy calculation.
learnerActions: Examine a real food label and identify the energy line, distinguishing the kJ value from the kcal value.
Tell apart the 'per 100 g' column from the 'per portion' column and say which to use for a given serving.
For a stated portion mass, say which figure to read or how to scale from per-100g.
activities.title: Read the label before you calculate
